positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Worked on developing a simulating traffic based on given travel demand. The outcome of the project is a web-based hybrid (microscopic-macroscopic) traffic simulator.

Technologies used:
- Java, Java EE, JSP, JUnit, Hibernate, Tomcat, Apache, Mysql Server
- HTML/CSS, Javascript, JQuery, AJAX, XML, JSON, Web API, ZK framework
- Eclipse, Maven, Ant, SVN, GoogleMap
